before.requirement: When an injected allocation failure is reported during XInclude processing, xmlXIncludeGetLastError must return XML_ERR_NO_MEMORY for the context.
before.reason: The memory-error helper sets errNo, and the getter returns it. The supplied allocator and URL propagation evidence does not establish a feasible input reaching this reporting path.

after.requirement: For the same reported allocation failure, xmlXIncludeGetLastError must return XML_ERR_NO_MEMORY for the context.
after.reason: The helper delegates to xmlRaiseMemoryError without directly setting errNo. The delegate's effect and a feasible injected failure are not established.

claims.reason: The same old harness and error-code requirement apply on both sides. The direct assignment disappears after the change, but the missing allocator behavior, URL propagation, and delegated error reporting prevent a definite before/after status comparison.
missing_information: Complete fuzz/fuzz.c::xmlFuzzMemSetup and the allocator callback definitions it installs.
Complete parser.c::xmlDoRead to determine whether the supplied URL becomes doc->URL.
Complete before and after error.c::xmlRaiseMemoryError, including any effect on the XInclude context's errNo.
Whether the installed allocator callbacks can make an XInclude allocation fail after parsing succeeds.
Whether a fuzzer-supplied document URL reaches the root URL allocation.
Whether xmlRaiseMemoryError updates the XInclude context error code.
